description_en: Queries the output list of the current user with support for conditional filtering and pagination
description_zh: 查询当前用户的产出列表，支持按条件过滤和分页
name: ListOutputFiles

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass it explicitly with --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the digital employee (operating object). Used to filter results by name
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工（运营对象）名称，按名称过滤
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the output item. Valid values: ppt, html, document, picture, slides, video, audio, email, and others
parameters.name: item_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword for searching. Matches output titles or item names
parameters.help_zh: 关键词搜索，匹配产出标题或明细名称
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display only outputs and output items that have sharing enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅展示开启分享的产出和产出明细
parameters.name: shared_only

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size
